decision_needed.question: The Light Fund (fiscal year ended April 30, 2025) shows transfers out of 3,020,000, but governmental funds (year ended Sept 30, 2025) show only 2,300,678 transfers in against 2,004,990 out. General Fund transfers out of 2,004,990 match the other funds' inflows except General's own 250,000 and Street's 45,688 (295,688 total), and no governmental fund shows receiving the Light Fund's 3,020,000. Is the Light transfer a one-sided transfer or does it land elsewhere?
decision_needed.recorded_as: business_type.transfers_net -3,020,000; governmental transfers in 2,300,678 and out 2,004,990 as printed

notes: Governmental funds are cash (modified cash) basis, year ended 9/30/2025; business-type funds (Light, Water, Sewer) are accrual basis, year ended 4/30/2025 (net position measure). Basis recorded as cash. Governmental beginning/ending are the fund-balance roll-forward on Exhibit E (Oct 1 10,724,946 to Sep 30 10,110,356), used as cash balance (fund balances; total assets 10,113,356 less 3,000 warrants). Governmental receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds 2025 column (pp5-6). Combined 'Debt service' expenditure line 233,410 split into principal 180,000, interest 51,415 and fees 1,995 using Schedule 21 (p36-37). Interest paid (2,650) and principal paid (34,779) on long-term debt are printed under Other financing sources (uses), below total expenditures, so recorded as disbursements with outside_printed_total; identity: 10,724,946 + 6,219,300 - 7,092,149 - 37,429 + 2,300,678 - 2,004,990 = 10,110,356. Business-type: no single receipts/disbursements total printed, computed (see reported_totals); farm income/expenses is printed as a net figure. business_type roll-forward: 24,288,314 + 12,423,549 - 10,655,582 - 3,020,000 = 23,036,281. Proprietary cash-flow data from Exhibit I totals column (p10). Balance sheet is Exhibit A government-wide Totals 2025 column (governmental modified cash plus business-type accrual; different fiscal year ends). The report has no per-fund Light/Water/Sewer budget schedules (Schedule 23, p39, is one combined proprietary budget comparison, accrual actual vs cash budget), so business-type detail per fund is taken from Exhibit H (operating revenues and operating expenses by fund; budget_final null; non-operating lines by fund added to detail with outside_printed_total, since they are printed below the operating totals; zero-valued Sale of assets omitted). Schedule 22 (combined receipts and disbursements vs budget, p38) not entered in detail to avoid double counting. Fund schedules: zero-valued lines omitted (Fire Fund, Fire Equipment, Equipment Reserve revenue, etc.). Detail General Fund uses Schedule 1 (p11). Fire Equipment fund all zeros. Transfer cross-check: transfers in by fund (p11-15, 18-25, 27): General 250,000, Police 974,121, Street 45,688, Fire 20,000, Parks 250,000, Pool 200,072, Library 263,167, Museum 127,630, Community Building 35,000, Equipment Reserve 60,000, Grant Projects 75,000 = 2,300,678; General Fund transfers out 2,004,990 equals the inflows to Police, Fire, Parks, Pool, Library, Museum, Community Building, Equipment Reserve and Grant Projects exactly (2,004,990). General's 250,000 and Street's 45,688 inflows have no matching governmental outflow (likely from the Light Fund). Schedule 22 shows General disbursements 4,175,272 = 2,170,282 + 2,004,990 transfers, but the Exhibit E statement and Schedule 1 keep transfers separate, so no hidden transfer in spending. Schedule 22 also lists Trust and Agency Funds (skipped, fiduciary). Combined lines with 'Other' operating expenditures are marked miscellaneous expenditure with review. Read pages 1-39 of 39. Trimmed pp22-23: Schedule 9, combining statement of the nonmajor General-type funds (Fire, Fire Equipment, Parks, Pool, Library, Museum, Community Building, Equipment Reserve); every column agrees with the individual fund Schedules 10-17 already in detail (e.g. Parks 72,930/291,658, Library 3,329/307,790; totals 235,231 revenues, 1,181,945 expenditures, 955,869 transfers in), so it is not entered in detail (no double counting). It holds no Light/Water/Sewer data. The v8 re-trim added p5 (Exhibit D) and p8 (Exhibit F) reconciliations (fund balances 10,110,356 and net change (614,590) agree, nothing changed), pp18-21 Schedules 6-8 (nonmajor combining balance sheet, combining revenues/expenditures by General/Special Revenue/Debt Service, General-type combining balance sheet; every column agrees with the fund schedules already in detail, e.g. revenues 235,231 / 556,320 / 213,691, so not entered) and p39 Schedule 23 (combined proprietary budget comparison: actuals equal Exhibit H totals; kept out of detail to avoid double counting the per-fund Exhibit H lines).
